description: Real attributed quotes on psychology, philosophy, and the mind.

quotes.text: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: You have power over your mind, not outside events.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: We suffer more in imagination than in reality.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: Don't explain your philosophy. Embody it.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: Until you make the unconscious conscious, it will direct your life and you will call it fate.
quotes.author: Carl Jung

quotes.text: Everything that irritates us about others can lead us to an understanding of ourselves.
quotes.author: Carl Jung

quotes.text: I am not what happened to me. I am what I choose to become.
quotes.author: Carl Jung

quotes.text: Between stimulus and response there is a space. In that space is our power to choose.
quotes.author: Viktor Frankl

quotes.text: When we are no longer able to change a situation, we are challenged to change ourselves.
quotes.author: Viktor Frankl

quotes.text: He who has a why to live for can bear almost any how.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.text: And those who were seen dancing were thought to be insane by those who could not hear the music.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.text: He who knows others is wise. He who knows himself is enlightened.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: When I let go of what I am, I become what I might be.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: Everyone thinks of changing the world, but no one thinks of changing himself.
quotes.author: Leo Tolstoy

quotes.text: Desire is a contract you make with yourself to be unhappy until you get what you want.
quotes.author: Naval Ravikant

quotes.text: If you can't decide, the answer is no.
quotes.author: Naval Ravikant

quotes.text: Nothing in life is as important as you think it is when you are thinking about it.
quotes.author: Daniel Kahneman

quotes.text: The first principle is that you must not fool yourself. And you are the easiest person to fool.
quotes.author: Richard Feynman

quotes.text: It ain't what you don't know that gets you into trouble. It's what you know for sure that just ain't so.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.text: Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.text: The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.
quotes.author: Socrates

quotes.text: The man who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.text: What you think, you become.
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.text: The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
quotes.author: Rumi
